status: NOT FOR FABRICATION / NO COOLING PERFORMANCE CLAIM

parts.title: 6.0 × 5.4 m rest footprint
parts.why: Five cots arranged around a 1.3 m transverse circulation strip and 1.6 m front entry. Existing shaded premises should be considered before building this structure.
parts.limit: Ground bearing, drainage, accessible approach and foundations are unengineered. No accessibility compliance claim.

parts.title: Perimeter frame / span proposal
parts.why: An open pavilion keeps cross-ventilation paths and access visible. Perimeter posts keep the central front access route open.
parts.limit: Member dimensions only establish conceptual geometry; loading, bracing, joints, anchors and roof uplift require structural engineering.

parts.title: Shaded lower roof / insulation allowance
parts.why: A separate lower surface shields occupants from direct sun; 260 mm clear roof cavity is reserved between skins. Insulation selection is open.
parts.limit: No measured underside or radiant-temperature reduction. Condensation, fire, dust and service access need detailing.

parts.title: Reflective overhanging upper roof
parts.why: Deep chajja/verandah-like shade is adapted as a 600 mm overhang. A reflective exterior reduces solar absorption; performance depends on material, soiling and sun angle.
parts.limit: Flat concept envelope only: slope, drainage, fastening and reflectance specifications are not detailed.

parts.title: Raised shaded ridge / exhaust proposal
parts.why: A raised cap over the central roof slot provides a high-level path for warm air. It borrows the principle of high openings, not a promise of windcatcher performance.
parts.limit: Rain baffles, insect mesh, reverse flow and wind-pressure analysis remain open. This cannot generate ventilation without a driving pressure difference.

parts.title: West removable jaali screen
parts.why: Shades low-angle sun while retaining gaps for ventilation; modules can be removed or adjusted for actual sun and wind exposure.
parts.limit: Nominal slat geometry is not a validated porosity or pressure-loss design. More screening may reduce useful airflow.

parts.title: East removable jaali screen
parts.why: Shades low-angle sun while retaining gaps for ventilation; modules can be removed or adjusted for actual sun and wind exposure.
parts.limit: Nominal slat geometry is not a validated porosity or pressure-loss design. More screening may reduce useful airflow.

parts.title: Rear permeable screen
parts.why: Reduces direct exposure at cot head ends while keeping an open pavilion. Orientation must follow the surveyed site.
parts.limit: Sun paths and prevailing winds for the actual plot have not been surveyed.

parts.title: Reclining cot 1 / rest position
parts.why: 750 × 1900 mm nominal cot, 450 mm deck height, illustrative 20° backrest. Replaceable breathable surface rather than thick heat-retaining upholstery; worker chooses a comfortable posture.
parts.limit: Not a medical bed or a treatment posture. Capacity, stability, cleanability, transfers and backrest lock require supplier selection and testing. Do not leave an ill worker to sleep unattended.

parts.title: Individual fan 1 / adjustable concept
parts.why: One nominal 400 mm fan per cot targets an occupied resting zone. Local manual speed/off control avoids forcing everyone to accept the same airflow.
parts.limit: Illustrative fan, guard and stand; no supplier, fan curve, motor voltage, power or outdoor rating selected. A larger diameter or five fans does not establish adequate cooling.

parts.title: Air temperature / RH sensor 1
parts.why: Placed beside the cot at torso/head-zone height, away from controller heat. Per-zone readings reveal uneven conditions.
parts.limit: Radiation shield and location bias need validation. This measures air, not body temperature or BP. Distributed wiring/interface is a new design, not existing bench I²C over long cables.

parts.title: Local fan / assistance control 1
parts.why: Reachable local speed/off and assistance button; autonomous local controls should remain usable without cloud connectivity.
parts.limit: Reach and posture need user trials. The five-zone controller and wiring are proposed; current firmware supports the earlier bench only.

parts.title: Dry service cabinet / five-zone proposal
parts.why: Central protected distribution, controller and display; separate per-fan branch protection and feedback are required.
parts.limit: Not a wiring design. Electrical ratings, protection, earthing, enclosure IP, isolation and qualified installation are open.

parts.title: External reference air station
parts.why: An independent shaded, ventilated reference outside the pavilion enables paired environmental comparison.
parts.limit: Final radiation shielding and matching exposure require a test protocol; not an unshielded sun-heated sensor.

parts.title: External calibrated WBGT / validation reservation
parts.why: Reserve space for a calibrated occupational heat instrument and separate air-speed mapping. Environmental evaluation also needs workload, clothing and acclimatization context.
parts.limit: Illustrative instrument location only. A black sphere alone is not a complete WBGT instrument; no physiological verdict is produced.
